posts.text:
Intermediary conclusion for now:

Most of the good non-fluoride hydroxyapatite toothpaste like Nobs, Boka and Biomin are only sold in the US as most Europeans are blissfully unaware of the problem with fluoride

Trying to buy it on Amazon Europe you pay like 5x to 10x the price, https://t.co/nbUorS95Wc
quoted:
Guys, it's that time again

What's the best toothpaste?

Preferrably without fluoride etc, and as clean and bio and healthy as possible

Thank you!!!
posts.text_zh:
目前的阶段性结论：

大多数好用的无氟羟基磷灰石牙膏，比如 Nobs、Boka 和 Biomin，都只在美国销售，因为大部分欧洲人对氟化物的问题浑然不觉。

想在欧洲亚马逊上买，价格要贵 5 到 10 倍。（引用自己此前的帖子：问大家最好的牙膏是什么，最好无氟、尽量干净天然健康。）

posts.text: "What the smartest people (or nerds) do on the weekend is what everyone else will do during the week in ten years." https://t.co/pMg7ZBAaXb

posts.text_zh:

找方向

- 筛选评分低于 3.5 的 app
- 如果排名第一的 app 很久没更新，那就更加分……（正文到此截断）

posts.text:
the story of how stripe started is pretty fascinating (now it's a $159B company) 

john and patrick were 2 brothers from small town ireland, only 19 and 21 when they started stripe!

it's a good reminder that you don't need to be older or super experienced to build something big https://t.co/JSRPMPpols
posts.text_zh:
Stripe 的创业故事相当精彩（现在是一家 1590 亿美元的公司）。

John 和 Patrick 是来自爱尔兰小镇的两兄弟，创办 Stripe 时只有 19 岁和 21 岁！

这很好地提醒我们：要做出大事，不一定要年纪更大或经验特别丰富。

posts.text: the state of startups in 1 chart: acquire niche data, orchestrate ai agents and run the loop as fast as possible https://t.co/LvOJBhwFcK https://t.co/P99qe1hyCq
quoted:
building a company these days is basically a loop:

acquire valuable context
orchestrate agents to build on it
feed the data back in
call humans like an api
repeat

the best context/faster loop wins
posts.text_zh: 一张图看懂创业现状：获取细分领域数据，编排 AI agents，然后尽可能快地跑这个循环。（引用帖：如今创业基本就是一个循环——获取有价值的上下文、编排 agents 在其上构建、把数据回灌、像调用 API 一样调用人类、重复；上下文最好、循环最快的人赢。）
